cli: map(days, fn(d) => {line: d.line, month: d.value.month, day: d.value.day, year: d.value.year, places: d.value.places, stops: length(d.value.stops)})
map(get(days, 0).value.stops, fn(s) => {line: s.line, title: s.title, kind: s.kind, time: s.time, details: map(s.details, fn(d) => {key: d.key, value: d.value}), notes: s.notes})
map(get(days, 1).value.stops, fn(s) => {line: s.line, title: s.title, kind: s.kind, notes: s.notes})
map(sort_by(stops, fn(r) => r.at), fn(r) => {title: r.title, line: r.line, at: r.at, at_date: r.at_date})
map(sort_by(entries, fn(r) => r.at), fn(r) => {kind: r.kind, title: r.title, at: r.at})
map(diagnostics, fn(r) => {line: r.line, severity: r.severity, code: r.code, message: r.message})
map(filter(import("agenda").between(entries, today(), today() + 6d), fn(r) => r.kind == "stop"), fn(r) => {title: r.title, at: r.at})
map(filter(import("agenda").between(entries, today(), today() + 6d), fn(r) => r.kind == "stop"), fn(r) => {title: r.title, at: r.at})
